hook_text: One ship leaves Durban full of oranges and car parts. Another arrives full of phones and machines. Which is the export?
clip_script: Durban harbour, seen from the Bluff. Container ships, stacked with colourful boxes. Exports are goods South Africa sells to other countries: platinum, gold, coal, iron ore, cars, citrus fruit and wine. Imports are goods we buy from other countries: oil and petrol, machinery, phones, computers and medicines. China is one of our biggest trading partners, and our neighbours matter too. Exports bring money in. Imports bring goods in. Ports, rail and roads link us to the world.
visual_style: Whiteboard harbour with ships leaving loaded with export icons and arriving with import icons, arrows out to a world map.
mood: Busy and big, like standing beside a giant harbour.
pacing: One ship out, one ship in, then a quick tour of ports and partners.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three imported and three South African-made things in your kitchen.
